items.name: Tinnitus means hearing a sound that isn't there
Hyperacusis means real sound feels painful
Growing sound avoidance points to hyperacusis
Blocking sound all day makes it more sensitive

closing.headline: Check whether a sound is heard with nothing there, or a real sound feels painful.
closing.tip: Note whether sound-avoidance behavior is growing.
closing.cta: See an ENT for a hearing test if it persists beyond a few weeks.
